evaluation_method: Three fresh cold agents independently evaluated disjoint groups of three reviewer specialties against raw fixture rows only at the clean pinned head. Expectations, prior results, and validator contracts were unavailable during the blind runs. The senior-engineering portion of one grouped run was rejected without editing its raw return, then evaluated by one genuinely cold specialty-scoped rerun under the same exclusions. Active rows preserve returned classifications and wording with only explicit schema normalizations recorded below; they are evaluation summaries, not private session receipts.
